name: Can We Be Three?
storyline: Yolanda Rogers' career just hit rock bottom. Her star client, pop sensation Lamar Jelly, is behind bars for flinging his faeces at his drummer in a wild concert meltdown. Fired from her law firm and desperate for a change, Yolanda escapes to the sunny Dominican Republic for some much-needed R&R. But what starts as a simple vacation takes an unexpected twist when she runs into not one, but two of her ex-girlfriends—who are now happily together. Seeing their bliss sparks a bold idea in Yolanda: why not turn this love triangle into something even more exciting?
summary: “Can We Be Three?” is a playful and heartfelt Yuri Visual Novel and Dating Sim. Step into Yolanda’s shoes as she navigates sun-soaked days in the Dominican Republic, rekindles old flames, and discovers just how far she’ll go to find happiness.
